Homestead (src/structures/homestead.gd) builds it; ValleyWorld sets it on valley.json's harlan_homestead pad (its `site`). Pad space: x east from the pad's west edge, z south from its north edge, y over the pad.

buildings._doc: its door's long side and porch to the north (the yard, the lane), the chimney gable to the east, the woodpile's to the west
its door to the yard (north), the corral beside it to the east

corral._doc: peeled pine poles on posts beside the barn, its gate to the yard; one rail on the east side snapped (a repair job: corral_rail)

trough._doc: in the yard east of the lane's way in (the ford path's walk to the place stays clear), the pipe's spout over its east end

woodpile._doc: split cordwood stacked against the cabin's west gable

stock._doc: in the barn along its west wall: new sawn boards on two bearers and three bundles of shakes, bought for the repairs

stall._doc: the horse's stall along the barn's east side

spring._doc: valley.json's harlan_spring up the slope to the north-east: a plank box round the pool, stones on its rim; bored logs laid on the ground down to the trough, the last on a post over it
